experience.title: Application Support Engineer
highlights: Wrote and deployed Bash scripts for automated server restarts, cutting manual intervention and streamlining routine maintenance.
Supported configuration management and pull requests for TELUS Health software developers and data engineers using Git, GitHub and Visual Studio Code.
Administered configurations in the Google Cloud console and tracked work in Jira, using PagerDuty alerting for fast incident triage and strict SLA adherence.
Helped achieve a 99.99% uptime SLA for critical production systems.
Implemented monitoring that reduced mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 60%.
Supported enterprise data pipelines, system loads and ETL workflows in Informatica and DataHub, keeping source-to-target data in sync.
Provisioned secure access through AccessNow for Domo, Looker and Tableau reporting environments for internal and external stakeholders.

experience.title: Application Operations Engineer
highlights: Provide L1 and L2 Production Support, leveraging technologies such as Azure Data Factory, CA Workload Automation (Autosys), Dynatrace, Feedhub, Jenkins, Linux/Unix server, Microsoft Azure, OpenShift, PegaSystems, Splunk, JBoss, and WebLogic. Manage updates, renewals, and expirations of certificates.
Handled incident and problem management: root cause analysis, recovery, notifications, and daily incident review and reporting.
Ran change management end to end: change records, exemption approvals, and representing changes to the Change Advisory Board (CAB) and Technical Advisory Board (TAB).
Established disaster recovery procedures that helped sustain 99.9% uptime.
Helped teams implement changes, verified services after deployments, and ran health checks.
Automated Linux server tasks with Bash scripts and streamlined reporting with Excel macros.
Handled batch jobs and acted as liaison between vendors and internal and external teams.
Joined post-implementation knowledge transfer and technical verification, and maintained knowledge-base documentation.
